title: Dune Allen Delight | Gulf Front Retreat | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Dune Allen Delight is a Gulf-front, pet-friendly 30A home with panoramic views, updated interiors, bikes, and walkable access to dining and fishing.
description_expanded: Dune Allen Delight Features - Gulf Front home with oversized Gulf facing porches featuring Adirondack seating and outdoor dining for 6 - All new floors, bathrooms, and kitchen updates for 2024 to ensure your family has a beautiful and restful spot to vacation in style. - Pet Friendly for up to 2 dogs, 45 pounds or less, and non-shedding. Approval from Exclusive 30A and payment of a non-refundable pet fee is required prior to your arrival. (Dogs not allowed on the beach per county ordinance) - Complimentary Use of 4 Taxi Bikes, serviced regularly to ensure they are in top shape for your arrival - Gulf views from all levels of the home - Top floor lounge with TV. Access by a spiral staircase - Full Kitchen - stocked with cookware and dinnerware - Dining table with seating for 6 - TVs throughout the home including Roku TV in the living room. - Must climb stairs to enter/exit the home, or access the beach - On-site Parking for 2 cars. Trailers and RVs not allowed due to space limitations - WIFI and streaming services available - Washer and dryer - Outdoor Propane Grill - Outdoor hose and shower available to wash off after a day on the sand - Workspace with desk and chairs on top floor with a Gulf view - Nearby restaurants - bike to world famous Stinky's Fish Camp, Shunk Gulley, The Perfect Pig, and Vue on 30A - Bait, tackle, and fishing licenses available at Stinky's Bait Shack. Only a 3-minute bike ride from the home. - 10 minutes to great shopping and dining at Grand Boulevard at Sandestin, Publix, Walmart, 98 Bar-B-Que, Louis Louis, Bayou Bill's Crab House, and more - 4-Minute drive to Topsail Hill Preserve State Park. Enjoy hiking, 3 miles of protected dune lined beaches, birdwatching, and more at this beautiful State Park. - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee - Concierge services available, including grocery delivery, additional bike rentals, catered beach bonfires, boat charters, and more Welcome to Dune Allen Delight. The renovations are complete, and we are excited for you to enjoy all the updates. This home offers an open floor plan with walls of windows to enjoy the breathtaking views as you enjoy your time relaxing with your crew. An open kitchen allows for casual dining while the living room offers a sofa and Roku TV for all your entertainment needs. All bedrooms are on the main floor as well as two full, shared bathrooms. The home is ideally set up for two families to enjoy, with each family having their own wing of the home for sleeping. Each wing of the home can also be shut off for additional privacy. Climb the elegant spiral staircase and enjoy the top floor lounge with doors leading out to another sunny balcony. A second living area on this top level includes a queen sleeper sofa, a TV, powder room and a charming built-in bar. Dune Allen Delight is located close to shopping and dining while offering the peaceful solitude of a Gulf front home in Dune Allen. Truly the best of both worlds! Walk to Stinky's Bait Shack for Sunrise Happy Hour and Cherry Coffee Roasters coffee from New Orleans. Pick up a fishing license and bait for beach fishing while you are there. Set up your fishing pole directly in front of the home! Take a bike ride down 30A to shopping and dining at Gulf Place, including top rated Shunk Gulley and The Perfect Pig. Walmart and Publix are less than 10 minutes away for groceries and beach supplies. And don't forget Topsail State Park is only 5 minutes away for family adventures. ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
